content.short: Pass App simplifies crypto management with advanced security and a seamless, personalized experience.
content.description: Pass App redefines smart wallets by making onchain interactions simpler and safer. It delivers personalized recommendations that surface Web3 opportunities tailored to each user’s interests, while advanced security features like passkey protection and Fallback Recovery remove the need for passwords or seed phrases. Users can transact across Ethereum, Base, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Polygon, and BNB Chain, paying network fees with any token, all from a single, cohesive wallet.
content.meta: Pass App is a Web3 wallet platform. Discover Pass App and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
